rows.section: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Humanitarian Crises
Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Humanitarian Crises
rows.en: In your group, discuss and answer the following question.
rows.ne: आफ्नो समूहमा निम्न प्रश्नबारे छलफल गरी उत्तर दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Discuss the following question in your group and answer it.

rows.section: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Humanitarian Crises
rows.en: Make a brief presentation on your flip chart and select someone to present it.
rows.ne: आफ्नो फ्लिप चार्टमा छोटो प्रस्तुति तयार गर्नुहोस् र त्यसलाई प्रस्तुत गर्न एक जना छान्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Prepare a short presentation on your flip chart and choose one person to present it.

rows.section: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Humanitarian Crises
rows.en: What can people, organizations, and governments in different areas (health, education, social welfare, etc.) do at each layer of this model to help people with their mental health and psychosocial needs?
rows.ne: विभिन्न क्षेत्रका (स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, सामाजिक कल्याण आदि) व्यक्ति, संस्था र सरकारहरूले मानिसहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक आवश्यकता पूरा गर्न सहयोग पुर्‍याउन यस ढाँचाको प्रत्येक तहमा के गर्न सक्छन्?
rows.bt: What can individuals, organizations and governments from various sectors (health, education, social welfare, etc.) do at each level of this framework to help meet people's mental health and psychosocial needs?
rows.note: An ordinary group discussion question, not a validated assessment item. T157 is a supplied unreviewed candidate.

rows.section: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Humanitarian Crises
rows.en: If possible, include examples from your own experience.
rows.ne: सम्भव भएमा, आफ्नै अनुभवका उदाहरणहरू समावेश गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: If possible, include examples from your own experience.

rows.section: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Humanitarian Crises
Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Humanitarian Crises
rows.en: Composite term “any type of support that aims to protect or promote psychosocial well-being and/or prevent or treat mental disorders”
rows.ne: संयुक्त पद: “मनोसामाजिक कल्याणको संरक्षण वा प्रवर्धन गर्ने र/वा मानसिक विकारहरूको रोकथाम वा उपचार गर्ने उद्देश्य भएको जुनसुकै प्रकारको सहयोग”।
rows.bt: Combined term: “Any type of assistance that has the purpose of protecting or promoting psychosocial well-being and/or preventing or treating mental disorders.”
rows.note: Preserves any type of support, its intended aims, both alternatives within each aim, and the and/or relationship between the aims.
